operating_mode.input: What this system takes in is hard demands, not vague possibilities. The year stem Yi arrives as Seven Killings: deadlines, standards someone else set, tasks too heavy for others. That is your fuel line. You also take in method and backing — hidden Bing fire in both Snake branches runs as Direct Resource, so instruction manuals, credentials, and proven systems feed you too. What you do not ingest: negotiation signals, price cues, status moves — Direct Officer sits empty and the Wealth family carries almost nothing, so opportunities to claim value literally do not register as input. When someone says 'what are your terms', the message bounces off; when someone says 'this must ship Friday', it lands instantly.
operating_mode.processing: Processing is absorption-then-craft. A demand arrives, you go quiet, and the Direct Resource layer — method from the two Snake branches — breaks it into steps before it hits you raw. Then Eating God, jointly heaviest with Companion, converts the load into making: your month stem Xin works beside you, hidden Xin in the day branch You works under your feet. Strong Ji earth holds the pressure while the craft drains it. Crucially, the conversion stops there: with water absent from all eight visible characters, the system has no built-in step that turns finished work into price or position. Processing ends at the object, not at the deal.
operating_mode.output: Output is the finished thing itself — the working version, the fixed item, the demonstrated method — delivered silently and early. While others are still confirming requirements, you hand back a prototype. Your peers see it and trust you more; your peers then hand you the next hard task, and Companion weight, your mirror self at the hour stem Ji plus the hidden earth, agrees to carry it. The loop output is therefore twofold: the craft object going out, and a tightening ring of expectations coming back. What the system does not output is a claim: no rate, no title demand, no named credit — the return channel stays closed.
operating_mode.recovery: Recovery comes through the hands, not through rest. Finishing a piece makes you feel lighter, not emptier — Eating God release genuinely takes pressure off a strong self. Cooking a full meal, fixing something physical, teaching by demonstration all recharge you because they run the same drain in a low-stakes register. Working alongside one equal also restores you — Companion at heaviest weight means shared labor is energizing, not draining. What does not recharge you: retreat into pure leisure without making anything, and long stretches alone with no peer at your level — your heaviest force operates horizontally and starves without equals nearby.

failure_environments.env: Deep hierarchy where price and promotion are decided two levels above you
failure_environments.mechanism: The failure traces to the loop's far end. You absorb a demand through Seven Killings, buffer it with Direct Resource, and hand back craft through Eating God — then the output disappears into someone else's report. With Direct Officer empty and water missing from the chart, the return channel must be built by the environment; here nobody builds it. The better you deliver, the heavier the next demand from the same unchanging terms, and the quiet satisfaction at finishing is followed each time by the small drop of unconverted energy leaving the system. Recognition converts into load instead of standing, and peers learn that handing you the hard task always works.

failure_environments.env: Places where the only recognized skill is managing upward
failure_environments.mechanism: Your entire heavy machinery — Companion and Eating God, jointly heaviest — runs horizontally: equals and objects. Rob Wealth, the reflex to compete head-on for resources, carries only two weight; Hurting Officer, the urge to publicly challenge rules, the same; Indirect Wealth, the nose for opportunity, barely one. In a setting that rewards self-promotion and vertical maneuvering, you are being asked to run on your three thinnest circuits while your two heaviest ones idle. You watch louder colleagues convert half your output into standing. The trigger for silent over-absorption fires: you take the work, they take the credit, and the loop tightens without any release.

failure_environments.env: Solo positions with no peers of your own level
failure_environments.mechanism: Companion weight comes from the hour stem Ji matching you, plus hidden earth in the Ox and both Snake branches — the earth element runs through three of the visible characters. That force is peer-mode: your trust and your energy live with equals. Alone among only superiors and juniors, the heaviest part of the system has no counterpart to work with, so self-reliance turns into pure self-replication — you pick up every stalled task personally because your mirror self is the only collaborator available. With a strong Day Master, Companion adds load rather than relief in that configuration, and the pressure-to-buffer-to-craft chain runs with no one to split the weight.

ideal_life_structure.time: Structure your time in maker blocks, not meeting grids. Long unbroken stretches — half-days at minimum — where you sit down with a spec and come back with the thing. Eating God production works without mood or perfect conditions, so the value comes from volume of finished output, and every interruption to the block cuts directly into your one working release valve. Schedule the absorbing part — reading requirements, studying method, the Direct Resource activity of both Snake branches — as its own quiet block, separate from making. Administrative time, especially anything about terms or price, deserves its own named slot: because that channel is unweighted in the chart, it will never happen spontaneously and must be put on the calendar by force.
ideal_life_structure.collaboration: Dense horizontal, thin vertical — with one exception. Work in small teams of equals where each peer owns a craft; that is where Companion operates at full efficiency and where trust flows back to you naturally. Keep the vertical axis deliberately short: you need direct access to whoever approves the budget and sets the terms, because your empty Direct Officer channel means anything routed through intermediaries gets priced by someone else, usually at zero. One decision-maker, a handful of equals, no layers between — in that shape, the person who watches you deliver can also pay you for it, and the loop's return end gets wired without you having to become a negotiator overnight.
ideal_life_structure.feedback_cycle: Two clocks running at different speeds. The fast clock is craft feedback: you need to see your output working — the prototype running, the thing fixed, the student demonstrating — within days, because Eating God release is also your recovery; long gaps without visible results starve both. The slow clock is the terms clock: quarterly, not daily, sit down and check whether the last cycle of work converted into anything banked — a rate change, a title, a named credit. The chart will not prompt this check on its own, since the Wealth family carries almost nothing, so the slow clock must be externalized: a recurring calendar entry, or an equal who asks you the question each quarter.
ideal_life_structure.income_rhythm: Prefer income tied to delivered objects, not to elapsed presence. Project rates, piece pricing, retainers scoped to output — anything where the finished thing itself carries the number. A pure salary paid for time rewards exactly the channel you lack and punishes your heaviest one: you would absorb unlimited demands at one flat price. Water, your Wealth carrier, is absent from the visible chart, so money does not flow to you incidentally; it must be attached structurally to what you already produce. The stretches beginning around age forty-two and fifty-two, when water branches finally run through the luck cycle, make terms-and-price conversations feel less foreign — build the attachment habit now so the channel is ready when the flow arrives.

stability_vs_volatility.verdict: Stable base with one deliberate, self-chosen bet — not a fully stable life, not a high-variance one.
stability_vs_volatility.reason: The system's engine is built for steady throughput: a strong Ji earth self holding load, Direct Resource buffering incoming pressure, Eating God converting it into output on a reliable schedule. That machinery degrades under randomness — it needs continuous craft production because output is also its pressure release, and it needs known terms because its return channel is unweighted and cannot be improvised under stress. But a fully fixed life has its own failure mode here: with Indirect Wealth at barely one weight and Rob Wealth thin, an employer who prices you once can hold that price forever, and the loop tightens for decades. So the variance must be added on purpose, on your terms, in the one place the structure supports it.
stability_vs_volatility.precondition: The precondition is sequencing: stable income first, attached to delivered objects, covering the base load; the deliberate bet second, and the bet must be a craft bet — a product, a body of work, a named method — never a negotiation bet or a pure opportunity chase. Direct Resource from the hidden Bing fire in both Snake branches means you study and prepare before launching, which suits slow-built bets. And the return channel must be pre-wired: before starting any bet, write down what it pays back in rate, title, or credit — because with water missing from the chart, if you do not define the return, this system will happily run the whole bet as more absorption with nothing flowing back.

environment_checklist: Will the person who watches my output also be the person who sets my price, rate, or title? If a intermediary or committee stands between delivery and reward, the loop's far end stays closed — this is the single highest-weight question for this structure, since Direct Officer is empty and water is absent from the visible chart.

Is there at least one true equal in the room — someone at my level whose craft I respect and who can take half of a stalled task? If no, my heaviest force has nothing to work with, and self-reliance becomes the only mode until it burns slow.

When someone here delivers excellent work, does their name visibly appear on it — in a credit line, a client-facing role, a signed release? If finished things vanish into reports, my output converts into someone else's standing while my next demand gets heavier.

Can I name the last person here who asked for better terms and still got promoted? If asking about money quietly ends careers in this place, then the belief 'good work speaks for itself' gets reinforced daily, and the ceiling closes manually regardless of my delivery record.

Will at least half my working time sit in unbroken maker blocks with a spec in hand? If the calendar is mostly coordination and status meetings, my one release valve — Eating God production — never opens, and absorbed pressure accumulates in a strong self with nowhere to drain.
